tool.name: GenerateBrandedThumbnails

param.name: folder
param.dialogReference: The folder of your content to search. The list is filled from your account when the dialog opens: (all my folders), (root folder) and each of your folders. The default is (all my folders).

param.name: tag
param.dialogReference: Only items that carry this tag (not case sensitive), for example a tag you give your test items. Leave it empty for every hosted feature layer in the folder.

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: The folder that receives one 600 x 400 PNG per item, named after the item title.

param.name: footer
param.dialogReference: The text at the bottom of every thumbnail, for example your organization or project name. The default is All Things Spatial.

param.name: colors
param.dialogReference: The background and accent colors of the thumbnail. The default is Navy.

param.name: update_items
param.dialogReference:
• Unchecked (default): the PNGs are written to the output folder only, so you can check them first.

  • Checked: the tool also replaces the thumbnail of every matching item you own. The dialog shows a warning while it is checked.

param.name: updated_count
param.dialogReference: The number of item thumbnails replaced in the portal (0 in a preview run).

tool.summary: Draws a 600 x 400 PNG thumbnail (item title, number of layers and features, footer) for each hosted feature layer you own and, only when Update Thumbnails on the Portal is checked, replaces the item thumbnail in the portal ArcGIS Pro is signed in to.
tool.usage:
• Run it first with Update Thumbnails on the Portal unchecked and look at the PNGs.

  • Only items you own are changed, and only their thumbnail. The tool does not change data, sharing or any other item detail.

  • ArcGIS Online stores the full 600 x 400 image and shows smaller copies in lists and galleries.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Give your hosted feature layers consistent, branded thumbnails.
